name: dsh-routing-suite
description: dsh-routing-suite — injector + router-standard kit: install the runtime injector first, then the task-aware reasoning-mode router preset (measured P1-P23).
zh: DSH 路由套件：注入器 + 任务感知推理模式路由器预设，按场景自动切换推理档位。

name: dsh-desktop
description: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件生态打造的现代化桌面端解决方案。万物皆「插件」，桌面本身也是「插件」。
zh: 为 DSH 插件生态打造的现代化桌面端壳层，把桌面本身也做成插件。

name: archify
description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
zh: 面向 Agent 的画图技能：架构图 / 流程图 / 时序图，输出带动效、可导出的自包含 HTML。

name: distilly
description: Distilly — Distill how they think into reusable Skills for any Agent or Bot. Formerly Colleague Skill.
zh: 把“它们怎么思考”蒸馏成可复用的技能（Skills），供任意 Agent / Bot 调用。
